source.title: NIST Special Publication 800-128: Guide for Security-Focused Configuration Management of Information Systems
source.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
source.applicability: Provides standards for operating system configuration management including provisioning baselines, patching processes, and evidence collection. Section 4.2 specifically covers device encryption and Section 5.1 addresses remote workstation environments.
